blocks.content: The Commission shall consist of a Chairperson and not less than two and not more than six other Members to be appointed by the Central Government.

items: Exams often test the numerical composition: CCI has 1 Chairperson + Minimum 2 to Maximum 6 Members (Total strength: 3 to 7).
Note that appointments are made by the Central Government, not by the President of India.
Remember the minimum professional experience requirement for members is 15 years in specified domains.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Competition Commission of India (CCI) consists of a Chairperson and not less than two and not more than six other members.
All members and the Chairperson are appointed by the Central Government on the recommendation of a designated Selection Committee.
To be eligible for appointment, candidates must possess a minimum of 15 years of professional experience in relevant fields such as economics, law, finance, or public affairs.
The Chairperson and Members hold office for a term of 5 years or until attaining 65 years of age, whichever is earlier, and are eligible for re-appointment.
